Donald Trump’s net approval rating remains in the dumps at -26, according to The Economist’s tracker of YouGov polling. On September 9th the president will begin a two-day rally in Dallas, Texas—an oddity outside a presidential-election year. The jamboree is intended to gin up Republican support ahead of the midterms. Perhaps the organisers have been watching Mr Trump’s poll numbers. Seemingly worried about low-attendance, the party has been offering free tickets. [...] Methodology
